neighbours.label: the connective after the defining noun in a definition 'X is the idea/creation/process of/that ...'
fire: Photosynthesis is the conversion of sunlight into chemical energy by plants.
Democracy is the principle that power belongs to the people.
Erosion is the removal of soil and rock by wind and water.
Inflation is the idea that prices rise while money loses value.
Animation is the creation of moving images from a series of drawings.
Federalism is the belief that power should be shared between levels of government.
Composting is the breakdown of food scraps into rich garden soil.
Utilitarianism is the view that the right action produces the most happiness.
quiet: Plants use sunlight to make sugar in their leaves during the day.
The people voted in large numbers during the last election.
Wind and water slowly wore down the soil and rock on the hill.
Prices rose again this month while wages stayed flat.
The studio hired twenty artists to draw the new cartoon series.
Power is shared between the city council and the state.
We throw our food scraps on a pile in the back garden.
The philosopher wrote many books about happiness and duty.
